title: ISic004516. Mason's mark (sigma) from the Ionic temple at Syracuse
body:
Text encoding: Valentina Mignosa
1Σ

Text encoding: Valentina Mignosa
1Σ

Facsimile Images

Apparatus criticus

  • Text after photograph (Guzzardi 2012, 150 fig. 5)

English translation

Valentina Mignosa

Sigma-shaped mark, possibly a mu.

commentary

The mark is incised on a block in the second course of a three-course masonry structure within the perimeter of the cella. Guzzardi prefers to identify it as an archaic sigma, while acknowledging that it could instead be a mu with diverging legs. The block remained in situ. The stratigraphic sequence associates the structure with the construction of the cella in the late sixth or early fifth century BCE. Guzzardi interprets comparable signs on blocks from the temple as setting-out marks used to guide their positioning and orientation.

bibliography

  • Guzzardi 2012 145–151, 150 fig. 5; 174 n. 61

The sign is interpreted by Guzzardi as probably an archaic sigma, although a mu with diverging legs cannot be excluded.
